sourceVM.description: Tenant-local Cozystack VMInstance to capture. The source must be halted and have no active VMI.

mode.description: Copy keeps the source VMInstance. Convert retires it only after the template is verified Ready and the source UID/generation still match preflight.

excludeOpticalMedia.description: Exclude installer, VirtIO-driver, rescue and other optical VMDisk attachments from the reusable template.
